shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone surface
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces carry shallow relief with a rounded disc-like motif and curving incised lines, something almost any carving tradition could produce. A depicts a frontal, highly schematic anthropomorphic figure covered in abstract emblems (rings, spirals, banded chest), while B depicts a recumbent animal in strict profile with modelled musculature beneath the legs of another figure and a fluted upright object — different subjects, different viewpoint conventions, and a naturalistic rather than emblematic manner.
